Dear Mr. Jeffrey
We take note of your last 2 emails (the below and attached), in which you expressed your dissatisfaction regarding the last
Presentation that took place in Paris on the 2P of January 2019.
It is with great astonishment; and without emotions, we take note of your comments especially after our last productive and
positive meeting in Paris.
We do not question your mode of expression nor your approach but rather respect it. However, we consider it as subjective
— In Design there is nothing called "Nice" or "Ugly" it is not Engineering or Mathematics where 1 + 1 = 2.
Imagine if Frank Lloyd Wright presented the 'Falling Water" House (copy attached) and it was rejected. This most important
house would have never been built. We want to build you a house to the same level as the "Falling Water".
We wish to clarify few points and propose to you a Strategy for the future if you still wish to continue working with us:
1- Our current involvement is Master Plan with proposed Architecture Character and Space Program considering the
Project Constraints.
In good will; and in order to resolve Major Site Constraints and to define the Client's Requirements, we went way beyond
our contractual obligations and provided you in our last presentation the following:
- Our Initial Developed Architectural Concept/Approach
- Two Alternative Architectural Concepts/Approaches
- As-Built Site 3D Model
- 3 Optional 3D massing Studies.
We developed all the options to open up all the possible approach of the site development and not to resolve small details
like adding a window or enlarging a room. We believe that the main points like General Buildings Locations, General
Program, General Building Views, General Requirements are been met with minor exceptions.
This made us incur losses and costs that exceed our total contract value.
2- In the last presentation Xavier noted clearly that these Options (especially the third option) needs further development
and this presentation is to agree on a the General Design Approach.
3- We were expecting after this last meeting, that you chose One General Scheme / Option and based on which we can
start the Design Development Phase (with a New Higher Level Detailed Scope of Work, Involvement and Contract) to
cover the following tasks:
- Design Development of One Architectural Option
- Interior Design and Landscape Design Concept Design and further Detailed Design
- Engaging Engineering Office to work in parallel with us on the Project Design Development (Geotechnical, MEP,
Structure, Wind Testing, Hurricanes Simulation Modeling, etc,..). We already started our discussions with some.
- Involving Construction Company to work parallel with us on the Constructability and Logistics Plans and Pre-Studies. We
already started our discussions with some.
If we agree on high level Option to develop, all your comments and details can be incorporated as we go and this is a
common practice. But the comments should not hold the Project Development as we have major Constraints that we need
to look into at this stage if you need to complete this project in 3 to 4 years.

EFTA01063302

 4- Regarding your point about the project being too difficult. We are very confident about our Experience, we don't believe
in the word "difficult". We can Design and Build to you the Best and Biggest Project in the World — this is what we are good
at. We love challenges and we are experts in resolving it.
You appointed us to assist you in realizing this project, so we assume that you need to trust us and our approach (for sure
under your directives and guidance).
Our projects that we are involved in became master pieces and or projects to be history of countries.
5- We have no objection to design on site and to setup a design team there — we can discuss such involvement details and
costs if needed. We believe that this can be a plus, but with our 3D tools that we use we are able to simulate the site from
our office.
6- Regarding your point about Xavier's comment to keep the existing pool. I think there is a big misunderstanding as for
sure we don't want to keep the existing pool and the proof to that is that we eliminated it from our 3 options.
Stating the above, I think it is necessary to clarify our mutual commitments as soon as possible.
We remain at your disposal to discuss the next step and looking forward to continue working together on this exciting
project.
Regards,

Kifah laham
Chief Executive Officer
